title: Winnie | Summer blouse with artistic print
bodyHtml:
This lightweight blouse is your go-to piece for warm days when you want to look effortlessly put-together. The artistic print brings real character to any outfit, while the soft fabric sits beautifully against your skin without clinging. It's the kind of versatile piece that works just as well with simple trousers as it does dressed down on weekends.

Why you'll love it

  • Artistic print adds instant style and personality to your everyday wardrobe
  • Soft, breathable fabric keeps you comfortable when temperatures rise
  • The neckline flatters without being too revealing or restrictive
  • Beautifully skimming fit that follows your shape naturally
  • Long sleeves that work rolled up or worn full-length—your call
  • Easy to dress up with tailored trousers or keep casual with your favourite basics
  • Sits perfectly against your skin, so you can actually breathe through the day
